sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 31 by documenting compliance with miscellaneous construction controls applicable to active work scope.

Procedure Capture: Verify controls are implemented, exceptions are documented, and correction timelines are assigned.

Task Use: Complete during pre-task planning and weekly inspections; escalate unresolved gaps to Safety Officer review.
